en.title: General Education
en.text: At Eichendorffschule in Kelkheim, I completed secondary school, adapted to a new school system, and chose a technical apprenticeship.

en.text: I passed the IHK AEVO examination on 4 September 2026. The qualification confirms the vocational and pedagogical skills required to train apprentices in Germany.

hr.title: {{AEVO}} certifikat
